notes: two taḥwīl branches meet at Hushaym; the text writes Abbad, his father and Abu Hurayra once, after the second branch, so they form the shared tail
«قال مسدد قال أخبرني عبد الله بن أبي صالح» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
Abu Dawud's note «هما واحد عبد الله بن أبي صالح وعباد بن أبي صالح» is the compiler's claim that two names are one man: recorded, not applied (rule 9)
